name: 1987 livery (2005 update)
description: White, with a midnight-blue band through the windows from behind the forward door to the tail, a thin orange line under it and a broader muted-gold band under that. 'SINGAPORE AIRLINES' in spaced dark-blue capitals over the forward windows, a small Singapore flag just aft of it. Dark-blue fin with the gold Kris bird (three swept wing strokes over a curling foot) and an orange stripe down its trailing edge. White engines, dark-blue winglets.

areas.name: thin orange line, over the gold band

logos.description: The Singapore Airlines bird: three parallel gold strokes sweeping up and back like a wing, flowing at the bottom into a curl that reaches forward, on the dark-blue fin; it faces the nose on both sides.
A small Singapore flag (red over white, a white crescent and five stars in the red) just aft of the title.

titles.style: Dark-blue capitals, a medium-weight geometric sans with round O, G and C, generously spaced, over the forward windows.

A388.note: Measured on 9V-SKP (left side, 2025): 'SINGAPORE AIRLINES' between the decks, much larger than on the 787-10 (x 0.106 to 0.544, about 31 m, from just behind the first door), its capitals' tops just under the upper deck's windows and its baseline just over the main deck's; the flag aft of it at the same height. The cheatline's layers measured there too: the blue band over the main deck's windows (y -0.1 to 0.03), the orange line low in it, the gold band under it, from the first door's aft edge.

notes: Drawn from 2025-2026 photos of a 787-10, an A350 and an A380 (both sides). The cheatline's layers were measured on the 787 (band about 0.12 tall, orange line, gold band about 0.1) and set so the blue band covers the window line as on every type photographed; it runs to the tail cone. The Kris bird is simplified to one wing block with two dark gaps and a foot. Winglets dark blue on the A350 and 737; whether they carry the bird is not clear in these photos. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on 9V-SCU: the title runs x 0.119 to 0.426 (as drawn, within 0.01) and the cheatline's layers match; all its edges are straight, and the Kris bird stays simplified to straight-sided strokes (the artwork is the logo entry). On the A380 (9V-SKP, source 1) the cheatline's blue band covers the main deck's windows and 'SINGAPORE AIRLINES' sits between the decks, under the upper deck's windows; drawn on the A380's shape the cheatline, title and flag come from `types.A388`, measured there. The A380 isn't Singapore's commonest type, so drawnOn stays. 2026-11-26: the bird's own fin areas (gold strokes and navy gaps) are gone: the bird is the fin logo (SIA/kris-bird), and a renderer with a mark for it drew it twice, the areas' straight bars under the mark's curves.
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation (a few remembered colors, 2026-11-12). Third-generation livery from 1987 (metallic gold band with the orange line over it, the orange line also behind the bird); updated in 2005 (bigger, more forward titles, a bigger bird, the band taken to the first window); engine logos dropped from 2007. Earlier: the 1972-1987 blue-and-yellow scheme.
